verdict.rationale: Azure is a cloud platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. A probe found an official MCP server documented in Microsoft's GitHub repository, which is direct first-party evidence that the capability exists. However, the pack has only that one thin mention: nothing on setup, tool coverage, authentication or agent connection flows. Missing for 10: details on how agents connect and authenticate, scope of the Azure tools exposed, maturity or GA status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://github.com/microsoft/mcp
